pull_request.title: docs: expand setup instructions for Windows users (#195)
pull_request.body:
Closes #195

The existing setup docs assume a Unix-like environment. This PR adds an
explicit Windows setup guide and links it from all relevant places so Windows
contributors can onboard without guessing.

### What's added

- `docs/windows_setup.md` — new full guide:
  - **Option A (recommended):** WSL2 with Ubuntu, matching CI.
  - **Option B:** Native PowerShell with the MSVC toolchain, Visual Studio
    Build Tools 2022 (incl. a concrete `Enter-VsDevShell` snippet so users
    don't have to detour through "x64 Native Tools Command Prompt for VS"),
    Git for Windows, PATH setup, and `.gitattributes` advice for LF line
    endings.
  - A **"Common Windows issues"** table covering `link.exe` errors, Defender
    exclusions, CRLF pitfalls (with `dos2unix` / `.gitattributes` — explicitly
    avoiding destructive commands like `git reset --hard`), `openssl-sys`
    workarounds, etc.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — Windows pointer at the top of "Setting up Locally".
- `README.md` — Windows callout added to "Getting Started → Prerequisites"
  (explains *why* Visual Studio Build Tools is needed: the MSVC `rustc`
  toolchain needs `link.exe`).
- `docs/SUMMARY.md` — new page registered in the gitbook TOC.
- `CHANGELOG.md` — `Unreleased > Added` entry.

### What is NOT in this PR

Issue #195's body referenced a `src/module_29.rs` "key file" alongside the
docs task. That instruction matches the same phantom-module pattern that was
already recorded as invalid in `CHANGELOG.md` (issue #207 / `src/module_17.rs`),
so `src/module_29.rs` was intentionally **not created**. This PR is strictly
docs.

### Validation

Three rounds of automated review on `docs/task-29` confirmed all flagged
issues resolved before commit:

- VS 2022 install paths now read `C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\…` (no `(x86)` suffix).
- Common Windows issues table replaced a dangerous `git reset --hard` recipe with `dos2unix` / `.gitattributes`.
- README.md Prerequisites now closes the loop on why Build Tools is needed.
- VsDevCmd callout now includes the concrete `Enter-VsDevShell` PowerShell snippet.
- Defender exclusion paths are consistent across the table.

`cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and `cargo test --workspace` — these are docs-only changes (no Rust source modifications) so they should pass trivially, but please run them locally before merging (the assistant sandbox doesn't have `cargo` installed).

### Conflicts

None. The branch was forked from a clean working tree on `docs/task-29`; nothing was merged from `main` during this work, so the diff applies cleanly.
